items.question: How early should I arrive?
items.answer: Five minutes is perfect. It gives us time to settle in and begin the consultation without rushing.

items.question: Can I book the same barber each time?
items.answer: Yes. Choose your barber when booking, or ask us to keep a recurring time for a membership.

items.question: What if I need to reschedule?
items.answer: Use the link in your confirmation up to twelve hours before the appointment, or call the studio.

items.question: Do you work with longer hair and textured styles?
items.answer: Yes. Our team works across lengths and textures. Add a note when booking so we reserve the right amount of time.
